verdict.rationale: The official quickstart walks a developer from console signup and API key creation to a runnable first request in curl, Python and JavaScript in one guide, with no sales contact needed. The OpenAI-compatible REST API also lets existing OpenAI client code work. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that time-to-first-call is actually minutes, documented runnable quickstart code beyond curl/Python/JavaScript, and a first call that does not require loading credits first.

support.subject: As a developer, a quickstart takes me from zero to a first successful API call in minutes, with runnable code in my language

citations.quote: Create an API key via the API Keys page, then export it or add it as an environment variable
followed by a runnable first request (curl/Python/JavaScript) in the same guide
The xAI REST API is compatible with the OpenAI REST API.
